provenance.construction: Cohn-Jiao-Kumar-Torquato, Geom. Topol. 15 (2011) 2235-2273, Theorem 7.5, with the cuboctahedron partitioned into 4 disjoint triangles (weight 8) instead of 2 triangles + 3 antipodal pairs (weight 7).
provenance.sets: four of the five 496-element subsets of the Leech minimal vectors used by Ma et al. (arXiv:2511.13391) in dimension 27, re-expressed in the coordinates of the note; verified to match their 27D data set-for-set
provenance.extra_spheres: the 12 extra spheres of Ma et al.'s dimension-27 configuration, unchanged
